name: 悠古的磐岩
bonus4pc: 获得结晶反应形成的晶片时，队伍中所有角色获得35%对应元素伤害加成，持续10秒。同时只能通过该效果获得一种元素伤害加成
bonus4pcEn: Upon obtaining an Elemental Shard created through a Crystallize Reaction, all party members gain a 35% Elemental DMG Bonus for that particular element for 10s. Elemental DMG Bonuses gained this way cannot stack.

name: 冰风迷途的勇士
bonus4pc: 攻击处于冰元素影响下的敌人时，暴击率提高20%；若敌人处于冻结状态下，则暴击率额外提高20%
bonus4pcEn: When a character attacks an enemy affected by Cryo, their CRIT Rate increases by 20%. If the enemy is Frozen, CRIT Rate increases by an additional 20%.

name: 染血的骑士道
bonus4pc: 击败敌人后的10秒内，施放重击时不消耗体力，且重击造成的伤害提升50%
bonus4pcEn: After defeating an opponent, increases Charged Attack DMG by 50% and reduces its Stamina cost to 0 for 10s.

name: 勇士之心
bonus4pc: 对生命值高于50%的敌人，造成的伤害增加30%
bonus4pcEn: Increases DMG by 30% against enemies with more than 50% HP.

name: 炽烈的炎之魔女
bonus4pc: 超载、燃烧反应造成的伤害提升40%，蒸发、融化反应的加成系数提高15%。施放元素战技后的10秒内，二件套的效果提高50%，该效果最多叠加3次
bonus4pcEn: Increases Overloaded and Burning DMG by 40%. Increases Vaporize and Melt DMG by 15%. Using an Elemental Skill increases the 2-Piece Set Bonus by 50% of its starting value for 10s. Max 3 stacks.

name: 深林的记忆
bonus4pc: 元素战技或元素爆发命中敌人后，使命中目标的草元素抗性降低30%，持续8秒。装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发该效果
bonus4pcEn: After Elemental Skills or Bursts hit opponents, the targets' Dendro RES will be decreased by 30% for 8s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

name: 沙上楼阁史话
bonus4pc: 装备者对敌人施放重击后，该敌人的风元素抗性降低30%，持续10秒；装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发该效果
bonus4pcEn: When the equipping character hits an opponent with a Charged Attack, the opponent's Anemo RES will be decreased by 30% for 10s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

name: 华馆梦醒形骸记
bonus4pc: 普通攻击时，有36%概率触发「山谷回响」：使普通攻击造成的伤害提高70%，该效果将在普通攻击造成伤害后的0.05秒后取消。普通攻击未触发「山谷回响」时，会使下次触发概率提高20%。触发「山谷回响」后的下一次触发概率默认为36%
bonus4pcEn: When a Normal Attack hits opponents, there is a 36% chance that it will trigger Valley Rite, which will increase Normal Attack DMG by 70% of ATK. This effect will be dispelled 0.05s after a Normal Attack deals DMG. If a Normal Attack fails to trigger Valley Rite, the odds of it triggering the next time will increase by 20%. This trigger can occur once every 0.2s.

name: 绝缘之旗印
bonus4pc: 施放元素爆发时，根据元素充能效率的25%，提高元素爆发造成的伤害。通过这种方式，至多提升75%元素爆发造成的伤害
bonus4pcEn: Increases Elemental Burst DMG by 25% of Energy Recharge. You can gain a maximum of 75% Elemental Burst DMG through this effect.

name: 乐园遗落之花
bonus4pc: 装备者触发的绽放、超绽放、烈绽放反应造成的伤害提升40%。此外，装备者触发绽放、超绽放、烈绽放反应后，上述效果带来的加成提升25%，该效果持续10秒，至多叠加4次，每秒至多触发一次。装备者处于队伍后台时依然能触发该效果
bonus4pcEn: The equipping character's Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG are increased by 40%. Additionally, after the equipping character triggers Bloom, Hyperbloom, or Burgeon, they will gain 25% bonus to the effect mentioned prior. Each stack lasts 10s. Max 4 stacks. This effect can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field. This effect can only be triggered once per second.

name: 赌徒
bonus2pc: 元素战技造成的伤害提升20%
bonus4pc: 击败敌人时，有50%概率删除元素战技的冷却时间。该效果每15秒至多触发一次
bonus4pcEn: Defeating an opponent has a 50% chance to reset Elemental Skill CD. Can only occur once every 15s.

name: 角斗士的终幕礼
bonus4pc: 装备该圣遗物套装的角色为单手剑、双手剑、长柄武器角色时，角色普通攻击造成的伤害提高35%
bonus4pcEn: If the wearer of this artifact set uses a Sword, Claymore, or Polearm, increases their Normal Attack DMG by 35%.

name: 黄金剧团
bonus2pc: 元素战技造成的伤害提升20%
bonus4pc: 元素战技造成的伤害提升25%；此外，装备者处于队伍后台时，元素战技造成的伤害额外提升25%
bonus4pcEn: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 25%. Additionally, when the equipping character is off-field, Elemental Skill DMG is further increased by 25%.

name: 沉沦之心
bonus4pc: 施放元素战技后的15秒内，普通攻击与重击造成的伤害提高30%
bonus4pcEn: After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 30% for 15s.

name: 华馆梦醒形骸记
bonus4pc: 装备该圣遗物套装的角色在以下情况下，将获得「问答」效果：在场上用岩元素攻击命中敌人后获得一层，每3秒触发一次；在队伍后台时，每3秒获得一层。每层「问答」效果提供6%防御力和6%岩元素伤害加成。最多叠加4层，未获得「问答」效果时，每6秒损失一层
bonus4pcEn: A character equipped with this Artifact set will obtain the Curiosity effect in the following situations: 1 stack when on the field dealing Geo DMG to opponents; 1 stack when off-field (triggers once every 3s). Each stack of Curiosity provides 6% DEF and 6% Geo DMG Bonus. Max 4 stacks. When off-field, each Curiosity stack is lost every 6s.

name: 教官
bonus4pc: 触发元素反应后，队伍中所有角色的元素精通提高120点，持续8秒
bonus4pcEn: Upon triggering an Elemental Reaction, increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 120 for 8s.

name: 渡过烈火的贤人
bonus4pc: 对处于火元素影响下的敌人造成的伤害提升35%
bonus4pcEn: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Pyro by 35%.

name: 被怜爱的少女
bonus2pc: 角色造成的治疗效果提升15%
bonus4pc: 施放元素战技或元素爆发后，为队伍中所有角色恢复生命值，回复量相当于佩戴者攻击力的10%，持续10秒
bonus4pcEn: Using an Elemental Skill or Burst increases healing received by all party members by 20% for 10s.

name: 逐影猎人
bonus2pc: 普通攻击与重击造成的伤害提高15%
bonus2pcEn: Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG +15%
bonus4pc: 当前生命值提升或降低时，暴击率提升12%，该效果持续5秒，至多叠加3次
bonus4pcEn: When current HP increases or decreases, CRIT Rate will be increased by 12% for 5s. Max 3 stacks.

name: 回声之林夜话
nameEn: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods
bonus4pc: 施放元素战技后的10秒内，岩元素伤害加成提升12%；若处于结晶反应产生的护盾庇护下，上述效果提升至150%，即提升18%岩元素伤害加成，该效果在失去护盾庇护后将持续1秒
bonus4pcEn: After using an Elemental Skill, gain a 12% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s. If the character is protected by a shield created through Crystallize, the Geo DMG Bonus is increased to 150% of its base value, i.e. 18% Geo DMG Bonus, lasting for 1s after the shield disappears.

name: 昔日宗室之仪
bonus2pc: 元素爆发造成的伤害提升20%
bonus4pc: 施放元素爆发后，队伍中所有角色（不包括装备者自己）的攻击力提升20%，持续12秒。该效果不可叠加
bonus4pcEn: Using an Elemental Burst increases all party members' ATK by 20% for 12s. This effect cannot stack.

name: 水仙之梦
bonus4pc: 普通攻击、重击、下落攻击、元素战技或元素爆发命中敌人后，将分别产生1层「水仙」效果。每层「水仙」效果提供7%攻击力和4%水元素伤害加成，持续8秒，最多叠加3层。该效果每0.3秒至多触发一次
bonus4pcEn: After Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts hit opponents, 1 stack of Mirrored Nymph will be triggered, lasting 8s. Mirrored Nymph: ATK +7%, Hydro DMG +4%. Max 3 stacks. Can be triggered once every 0.3s.

name: 海染砗磲
bonus2pc: 角色造成的治疗效果提升15%
bonus4pc: 装备此圣遗物套装的角色对队伍中的角色进行治疗时，将产生持续3秒的海染泡沫，记录治疗的生命值回复量（包括溢出值）。泡沫持续时间结束时，泡沫会破裂，对周围的敌人造成相当于记录的治疗量90%的伤害
bonus4pcEn: When the character equipping this artifact set heals, a Sea-Dyed Foam will appear for 3 seconds, accumulating the amount of HP recovered from healing (including overflow healing). At the end of the duration, the Sea-Dyed Foam will explode, dealing DMG to nearby opponents equal to 90% of the accumulated recovered HP.

name: 苍白之火
bonus4pc: 元素战技命中敌人后，攻击力提升9%，持续7秒。该效果至多叠加2层，每0.3秒至多触发一次。叠满2层时，二件套的效果提升100%
bonus4pcEn: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, ATK is increased by 9% for 7s. This effect stacks up to 2 times and can be triggered once every 0.3s. Once 2 stacks are reached, the 2-set bonus is increased by 100%.

name: 行者之心
bonus4pc: 重击的暴击率提升30%
bonus4pcEn: Increases Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 30%.

name: 逆飞的流星
bonus4pc: 处于护盾庇护下时，普通攻击和重击造成的伤害提高40%
bonus4pcEn: While protected by a shield, gain an additional 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG.

name: 学士
bonus4pc: 获得元素微粒或元素晶球时，队伍中所有弓箭和法器角色额外恢复3点元素能量。该效果每3秒至多触发一次
bonus4pcEn: Gaining Energy Particles or Orbs gives 3 Energy to all party members who use Bows or Catalysts. Can only occur once every 3s.

name: 追忆之注连
bonus4pc: 施放元素战技时，如果角色的元素能量不低于15点，则会流失15点元素能量，使接下来的10秒内普通攻击、重击、下落攻击造成的伤害提高50%，该效果持续期间不会再次流失元素能量
bonus4pcEn: When casting an Elemental Skill, if the character has 15 or more Energy, they lose 15 Energy and their Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 50% for 10s. This effect will not trigger again during that duration.

name: 昔时之歌
bonus2pc: 角色造成的治疗效果提升15%
bonus4pc: 装备者对队伍中的角色进行治疗时，将产生持续6秒的「彼岸莲歌」效果，记录治疗的生命值回复量（包括溢出值）。持续时间结束后，「彼岸莲歌」会转化为「彼时之歌」效果：队伍中所有角色造成的伤害提升相当于「彼岸莲歌」记录的治疗回复量8%的值，最多不超过5000点。该效果持续10秒，装备者处于队伍后台时也能触发
bonus4pcEn: When the equipping character heals a party member, the Yearning effect will be created for 6s, which records the total amount of healing provided (including overflow healing). When the duration ends, the Yearning effect will be transformed into the "Bygone Days" effect: All party members' DMG dealt is increased by 8% of the total healing amount recorded by the Yearning effect, up to a maximum of 5,000 DMG. This effect lasts 10s. Can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.

name: 千岩牢固
bonus4pc: 元素战技命中敌人后，队伍中附近的所有角色攻击力提升20%，护盾强效提升30%，持续3秒。该效果每0.5秒至多触发一次。装备此圣遗物套装的角色处于队伍后台时，依然能触发该效果
bonus4pcEn: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, the ATK of all nearby party members is increased by 20% and their Shield Strength is increased by 30% for 3s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

name: 如雷的盛怒
bonus4pc: 超载、感电、超导反应造成的伤害提升40%，激化反应带来的伤害提升提高20%。超载、感电、超导、激化反应发生后，施放元素战技的冷却时间减少1秒。该效果每0.8秒至多触发一次
bonus4pcEn: Increases DMG caused by Overloaded, Electro-Charged, and Superconduct by 40%. Triggers Quicken, Aggravate, and Hyperbloom DMG by 20%. When Quicken or the aforementioned Electro-based Elemental Reactions are triggered, Elemental Skill CD is decreased by 1s. Can only occur once every 0.8s.

name: 平息鸣雷的尊者
bonus4pc: 对处于雷元素影响下的敌人造成的伤害提升35%
bonus4pcEn: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Electro by 35%.

name: 奇迹
bonus4pc: 受到元素攻击后的10秒内，对应的元素抗性提升30%
bonus4pcEn: Within 10s of receiving Elemental DMG, increases the corresponding Elemental RES by 30%.

name: 辰砂往生录
bonus4pc: 施放元素爆发后，将获得「潜光」效果：攻击力提升8%，并在接下来的12秒内持续提升攻击力4%，每2秒提升一次。「潜光」效果至多叠加4次，并在角色退场时消失。「潜光」效果叠加时持续时间会刷新
bonus4pcEn: After using an Elemental Burst, this character will gain the Nascent Light effect, increasing their ATK by 8% for 16s. When the character's HP decreases, their ATK will further increase by 10%. This increase can occur this way a maximum of 4 times. This effect will be dispelled when the character leaves the field. The Nascent Light effect can only be triggered by Elemental Bursts. Each ATK increase triggered has independent durations.

name: 翠绿之影
bonus4pc: 扩散反应造成的伤害提升60%。根据扩散的元素类型，降低受到影响的敌人40%的对应元素抗性，持续10秒
bonus4pcEn: Increases Swirl DMG by 60%. Decreases opponent's Elemental RES to the element infused in the Swirl by 40% for 10s.

name: 花海甘露之光
bonus4pc: 元素战技和元素爆发造成的伤害提升，提升量相当于装备者生命值上限的2%。装备者受到伤害后的5秒内，上述提升效果提高80%，该效果至多叠加5次，每0.3秒至多触发一次
bonus4pcEn: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG will be increased by 2% of the equipping character's Max HP. After taking DMG, the equipping character's Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG will be increased by an additional 2% of Max HP for 5s. This effect can stack up to 5 times. Can be triggered once every 0.3s.

name: 流浪大地的乐团
bonus4pc: 装备该圣遗物套装的角色为法器、弓箭角色时，角色重击造成的伤害提高35%
bonus4pcEn: If the wearer of this artifact set uses a Catalyst or a Bow, increases their Charged Attack DMG by 35%.

name: 未完的遐想
bonus4pc: 装备者在场上每1秒未造成火元素伤害，攻击力提升6%，最多叠加3层，每层持续10秒。造成火元素伤害后的1秒内，上述加成效果变为2倍
bonus4pcEn: When the equipping character is on the field and has not dealt Pyro DMG for 1s, ATK is increased by 6%. Max 3 stacks. When the equipping character deals Pyro DMG, the above ATK bonus is doubled for 1s.

name: 谐律异想断章
bonus4pc: 当装备者附近的队伍中角色的生命值降低或恢复时，装备者获得1层「谐律」效果。每层「谐律」提供6%攻击力加成，最多叠加3层，持续6秒。该效果每0.2秒至多触发一次
bonus4pcEn: When nearby party members' HP decreases or when nearby party members are healed, the equipping character gains 1 stack of Harmony. Each stack of Harmony provides 6% ATK bonus. Max 3 stacks. Each stack lasts 6s. Can be triggered once every 0.2s.

name: 黑曜石秘典
nameEn: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
bonus2pc: 装备者触发「夜魂迸发」时，队伍中所有角色（不包括装备者自己）的攻击力提升12%，持续15秒
bonus2pcEn: When the equipping character triggers a Nightsoul Burst, all nearby party members' (excluding the equipping character) ATK is increased by 12% for 15s.
bonus4pc: 装备者触发对应元素反应后，该元素的伤害加成提升12%，持续15秒。通过这种方式至多提升2种元素伤害加成。如果装备者为「夜魂」角色，还会额外提升元素伤害加成12%
bonus4pcEn: After the equipping character triggers a corresponding Elemental Reaction, Elemental DMG Bonus for the corresponding element is increased by 12% for 15s. Max 2 elements. If the equipping character has Nightsoul points, the Elemental DMG Bonus is increased by an additional 12%.
